title: Patch: dungeon packs drawn and opened as real packs
thread:
**Issue #3588 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3588: Patch: dungeon packs drawn and opened as real packs
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

After a won fight the run offers four packs (§15.7): the beaten enemy's deck, a random one, a set's, and one of a card type, tag or rarity. The player opens one and keeps exactly `keep` of its cards. Today the reward screen (`apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RewardScreens.tsx`) draws the four as plain buttons with a label, and the opened pack as cards to toggle.

The owner wants good pack graphics, and the shop already has them in `apps/web/src/packs/`:
- `PackObject.tsx` draws a pack as an object you press and tear;
- `PackScene` in `PackOpening.tsx` plays the tear and the reveal, respecting the fx settings and reduced motion.

**The screen (presentation only, CLAUDE.md rule 7; the run's rules are untouched):**

- **The choice.** The four packs are drawn side by side as packs, wrapping on a phone. Each has its kind's look:
  - a set's pack is that set's pack as the shop draws it;
  - the enemy's pack is marked with the enemy's name, with a boss look for a boss;
  - the random pack and the type, tag or rarity pack each get a distinct look and their label.

  Hovering or focusing a pack lifts it. Choosing one sends the same action as today.
- **The opening.** The chosen pack tears open with the shop's animation and reveals its cards face up (`CardFace`). The player then keeps exactly `keep` cards, or skips the pack with a Skip passive, as today. The kept cards are marked, and a counter reads, for example, "2 of 3 kept".
- **Reuse.** Use what `apps/web/src/packs/` already has. Pull out a shared piece only if needed, without changing the shop's look or its tests.
- **Motion.** Under reduced motion, or with fx intensity off, the cards show at once.
- **Words.** Every word goes through `t()`, and `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` gets the new strings. Test ids go in `map/testids.ts`.

### Acceptance

- vitest: the four packs are drawn with their kind's label, and choosing one sends the same action as today.
- vitest: exactly `keep` cards can be kept, and Skip shows only with its passive.
- vitest: under reduced motion the cards show at once.
- The shop's pack tests (`apps/web/src/packs/*.test.tsx`) pass unchanged.
- The pull request carries screenshots at desktop and phone widths (the `ui-walkthrough` skill) of the four packs and an opened one.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e` and `pnpm --dir apps/web test` pass.

### Blocked by, part of

Part of #3581

### Difficulty (a guess)

medium

### Priority

medium

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42732470386)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

After a won fight the four reward packs render as tearable shop-style packs, and the opened pack tears open before its keep.

The choice draws the four packs side by side (wrapping on a phone) with `PackObject`: a set's pack exactly as the shop draws it, the enemy's pack carrying the beaten enemy's name with a boss look on a boss node, and distinct looks plus their labels for the random and the type/tag/rarity packs. Hover or focus lifts a pack; choosing one sends the same `openPack` action as today. The opening tears for `PACK_TEAR_MS`, then reveals its cards face up with kept cards marked and a counter like "2 of 3 kept"; Skip shows only with its passive. Reduced motion or fx intensity off shows the cards at once. No shop test changes; no run-rules change.

## Files to touch

| File | Kind | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/packs/packs.ts` | change | 4 dungeon pack ids, `packName` branches |
| `apps/web/src/packs/PackObject.tsx` | change | 4 dungeon emblems in `OWN_EMBLEMS` |
| `apps/web/src/packs/pack-object.css` | change | 4 `data-pack` color blocks |
| `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RewardScreens.tsx` | change | Pack buttons, tear/reveal, counter |
| `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/run.css` | change | Pack row, lift, counter classes |
| `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/testids.ts` | change | `packObject`, `packTear`, `packCounter` |
| `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.test.tsx` | change | Choice, keep/Skip, motion tests |
| `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | 6 new strings translated |

Do not touch: `apps/web/src/packs/*.test.tsx`, `PackOpening.tsx`, anything under `crates/`, `spec/`, `e2e/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing spec: §15.7 (packs), §14.3/§14.6 (shop pack look, reused unchanged), CLAUDE.md rule 7 (presentation only, same actions). No ruling: no undecided rule is settled.

## Steps

1. `packs.ts`: beside `COSMETIC_PACK`, add `DUNGEON_ENEMY_PACK` (`"dungeon-enemy"`), `DUNGEON_BOSS_PACK`, `DUNGEON_RANDOM_PACK`, `DUNGEON_FILTER_PACK`. Extend `packName`: enemy → `t("Enemy pack")`, boss → `t("Boss pack")`, random → `t("Random pack")`, filter → existing `t("Card pack")`. Nothing else in the file changes.
2. `PackObject.tsx`: add the four ids to `OWN_EMBLEMS` with original `glyphUri` SVGs in the file's style (no text/title): crossed swords (enemy), horned crown (boss), three dots/die (random), tag/funnel (filter). No existing entry changes.
3. `pack-object.css`: add one color block per id after the `cosmetic` block, each setting `--pack-foil-a/b`, `--pack-accent`, `--pack-crimp-a/b`, `--pack-ink` where needed. Distinct hues from all shop sets. No keyframes; no existing block changes.
4. `testids.ts`: add `packObject: (i) => dungeon-run-pack-object-${i}`, `packTear: "dungeon-run-pack-tear"`, `packCounter: "dungeon-run-pack-counter"`.
5. `RewardScreens.tsx` choice: add module helper `beatenEnemy(run)` returning `{name, boss} | null` from `run.map[run.row ?? -1]?.[run.col]` (`enemy` may be null; `boss` is `kind === "miniBoss" || kind === "boss"`; null when row is null). Add `packIdFor(kind, boss)`: set → its set name, boss-kind → boss id or enemy id, random → random id, others → filter id. Replace each `dungeon-run-choice` button with a `dungeon-run-pack-pick` button (same `pack(i)` testid, same `openPack` send) containing `PackObject pack={packIdFor(...)} size="shelf"` (boss-kind children: raw enemy name when known) plus the unchanged `packLabel(kind)` text and, for boss nodes, a `t("Boss")` tag. Keep `packLabel` exactly.
6. `RewardScreens.tsx` opening: in `PackScreen`, copy the `PackScene` motion lines (`useFxSettings`, `useSetting("reduceMotion")`, `reducedMotionNow`; `instant = reduced || fx.intensity === "off"`). Add `stage: "sealed" | "tearing" | "open"`, starting `"open"` when `instant` else `"sealed"`. Sealed shows a `packTear` button with `PackObject state` idle and hint `t("Tap to open")`; activating it sets `"tearing"` and a `PACK_TEAR_MS` timeout (cleaned up) sets `"open"`. Open shows the unchanged card grid, keep/Skip buttons, plus a `packCounter` paragraph with `t("{kept} of {keep} kept", {kept: String(selected.length), keep: String(phase.keep)})`. Toggle, keep-exactly, and Skip logic stay byte-identical. No audio, no swipe, no modal: the run's cards are already decided, so the server-driven `PackScene` is not reused (rejected alternative).
7. `run.css`: add `.dungeon-run-packs` (flex row, wrap, gap, centered), `.dungeon-run-pack-pick` (column, gap, padding, radius, raised background; `transition: transform 120ms`), its `:hover`/`:focus-visible` lift via `transform: translateY(-4px)` only, and `.dungeon-run-pack-counter` (dim, tabular numbers). Do not restyle existing classes.
8. `zh-CN.json`: add `Enemy pack` (敌方卡包), `Boss pack` (首领卡包), `Random pack` (随机卡包), `Boss` (首领), `Tap to open` (轻触开启), `{kept} of {keep} kept` (已保留 {kept} 张，共 {keep} 张). Match the glossary tone (`Card pack` → 卡包).
9. Tests in `RunScreen.test.tsx` (copy the file's `fakeDungeon`/`CONTENT`/`MAP` patterns): choice shows all four labels with enemy name on the boss pack, `data-pack` per kind (`dungeon-enemy`, boss node → `dungeon-boss`, set → `Core`), and click sends the same `openPack` index; counter reads `0 of 2 kept` then `1 of 2 kept`, third pick refused past keep; Skip absent/present as today; sealed shows tear button and no cards, click plus `vi.advanceTimersByTime(PACK_TEAR_MS)` shows them (copy `PackOpening.test.tsx`'s fake-timer pattern); `writeSettings({reduceMotion: true})` and `setFxSettings({intensity: "off"})` each show all cards at once with no tear button. No emoji anywhere (`noEmoji.test.ts`).
10. Screenshots: read `.claude/skills/ui-walkthrough/SKILL.md`, add a temporary dev route rendering `RewardScreen` (four-kind packs at a boss node) and `PackScreen` open state with the test file's fixtures, serve and capture desktop plus 390px widths of both, then delete the route and its registration. Save four PNGs under `screenshots-3588/` in the worktree.

## Tests

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.test.tsx` — all new plus existing B28 tests green.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/packs/PackObject.test.tsx` and `src/packs/PackOpening.test.tsx` — pass unchanged, unedited.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` — new strings have entries.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` for the touched area.

## Done when

- Four packs show with kind looks, labels, enemy name, and boss look; choice sends `openPack` with the same index.
- Opening tears then reveals face-up cards; exactly `keep` kept, counter correct, Skip only with passive.
- Reduced motion and fx-off show cards at once; phone layout wraps.
- Shop pack tests pass with no edits; typecheck, eslint, and the web tests pass.
- Screenshots at both widths exist under `screenshots-3588/`; the temporary dev route is deleted (`git status` shows only intended files).

## Risks

- Hidden information: none added — enemy name is already public on the map; `PackScreen` shows only `phase.cards` the run revealed.
- Rule 7: actions and logic unchanged; only rendering, motion, and labels change.
- Shop drift: `packs.ts`/`PackObject.tsx`/css edits are purely additive; the color-block and emblem tests assert subsets.
- Motion: transitions use transform only, no new keyframes, so the keyframe tests and reduced-motion paths hold.
- i18n: every new literal goes through `t()` at render with a `zh-CN.json` entry, or `i18n.test.ts` fails.

## Open questions

None. The only judgment call (temporary dev route for screenshots, deleted after) follows the repo's `routes/dev/` convention; if reviewers prefer no PNGs in the worktree, the harness can attach them from `screenshots-3588/` and drop the folder.
<!-- /jackioh-bot:plan -->
```
